description: A developer moving from UWP to WinUI 3 cannot find the XAML designer view, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/70292470/where-is-the-designer-view-in-winui-3.
prompt: I'm moving an old UWP screen over to a WinUI 3 desktop project and Visual Studio only gives me XAML text for MainWindow.xaml. Am I missing a designer option somewhere, or is my project set up wrong?
